verdict: Leads are coming in; converting them to consultations is the priority now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 37 leads at $100.85 per lead across $3,731.57 in total ad spend. Lead volume softened slightly in the most recent week — down 11% week-over-week — while cost per lead rose about 7%, a trend worth watching but not yet alarming. The more pressing gap is what happens after a lead arrives: 98 new opportunities are recorded in your pipeline, but none have converted to a booked consultation, and conversion tracking on Google Ads is being repaired so that campaign can be properly optimized. On a positive note, your organic search visibility jumped sharply this week, and we expect that to support inbound momentum heading into the next reporting window.
